description.text: Training objective: This major aims to cultivate interdisciplinary and high-quality leading talents in financial technology with solid theoretical knowledge of computer science, proficient IT skills, innovative spirit, practical ability, broad international vision and rich financial knowledge.Major Features: Focusing on the combination of computer science and technology and finance, this major focuses on the cultivation of computer professionals in the field of financial technology, and focuses on the cultivation of talents with good theoretical foundation and practical ability. It is the computer science and technology major with the most distinctive financial characteristics in China.Core Courses: Object-oriented programming (JAVA SE), Object-oriented Programming (JAVAEE), Programming (C language), Data structure, algorithm analysis and design, operating system, compilation principle, database Principle and application, computer network, Introduction to Artificial Intelligence, natural language processing, cloud computing, big data technology, digital image processing, blockchain technology, etc.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Bareheaded ID photo within half a year2. High school diploma or pre-graduation certificateIf the applicant is a current student, he/she must submit a pre-graduation certificate from his/her school, stating that the applicant will receive his/her graduation certificate by August 25, 2025.3. Complete high school transcripts4. Proof of language ability6. Passport Personal information page7. Foreigner Physical Examination Record8. Certificate of No Criminal Record9. Proof of financial guarantee10. Other documents that can prove learning ability and comprehensive quality, such as award certificates, published papers, etc

requirements.text: A non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport with good physical and mental health and excellent academic performanceComply with Chinese laws and regulations and school disciplineThe academic level must meet one of the following conditions: Fresh high school graduates recognized by the state shall obtain a high school graduation certificate recognized by the state before admission in the same year, otherwise the admission qualification is invalid. A high school diploma recognized by the state. Persons who have obtained a bachelor's degree. 4.18-35 years old 5.Applicants who are native English speakers, or who have provided evidence of two or more years of English-taught studies, may not provide evidence of English scores; Applicants whose mother tongue is not English must provide proof of IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 or above; Or pass the exam organized by the School of International Education of Southwestern University of Finance and Economics.
